wiki.title: Necrowart Zombie
wiki.text:
Were you looking for the pet pal?

The Necrowart Zombie is an enemy NPC that can be found mainly in Briarwood. It's appearance isn't much to be desired as they walk on all fours, frequently wheeze, are somewhat purple in pigmentation and have a mushroom growing out of their back.

Battle
Necrowart Zombies are mainly found wandering near the stream in Bristlewood, Briarwood and require a level 9 combat job to encounter. They also feature in some dungeons such as the Haunted Mines in Blackspore Swamp (which requires a level 13 combat job to enter) except they are referred to as Shamblers and do not have a mushroom growing out of their back. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Also if you own a level 11 or above farm you can purchase a fungus sprayer from the vending machine on your farm. This enables you to turn yourself and others into necrowart zombies. Also at Halloween if you are attacked by the Pumpkin Prince then a chance that you will turn into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter and will have to pick up another one once the effect has worn out.

wiki.title: Changelings
wiki.text:
Changelings are a mutated race of pixies that were stuck above ground during the Unbinding. The large waves of magic from the Unbinding mutated their bodies and minds, along with limbs transformed into elements of land such as sticks, branches, and stones. Most changelings are known to be sad, bitter creatures because of what happened to them and how people treat them now.Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide, Tracy West, page 83

Changelings appear in many dungeons and in Sacred Grove. During the Festival of Hearts, a group of changelings known as the Heart Breakers attempt to ruin the event and steal all of the love.

Notable Changelings

Behavior
Many of the changelings appear to be very unapproachable and hostile in nature. Their mutations have caused them to be mangled and considered ugly by some, so they often feel like an outcast race in Sacred Grove. Many changelings can be found isolated or alone in the corners of cities, towns, and even within their own small sanctuaries out in the Wilds.

Despite their sour behavior, some of the changelings still have good hearts, and will often help the player or give them quests to do to help.

enecrowart-zombie.title: Necrowart Zombie

wiki.title: Necrowart Zombie
wiki.text:
Were you looking for the pet pal?

The Necrowart Zombie is an enemy NPC that can be found mainly in Briarwood. It's appearance isn't much to be desired as they walk on all fours, frequently wheeze, are somewhat purple in pigmentation and have a mushroom growing out of their back.

Battle
Necrowart Zombies are mainly found wandering near the stream in Bristlewood, Briarwood and require a level 9 combat job to encounter. They also feature in some dungeons such as the Haunted Mines in Blackspore Swamp (which requires a level 13 combat job to enter) except they are referred to as Shamblers and do not have a mushroom growing out of their back. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Also if you own a level 11 or above farm you can purchase a fungus sprayer from the vending machine on your farm. This enables you to turn yourself and others into necrowart zombies. Also at Halloween if you are attacked by the Pumpkin Prince then a chance that you will turn into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter and will have to pick up another one once the effect has worn out.

Appearances
Den of Secrets
Moldy Shamblers!
Dark Spore Depths
Bergram Stumpfinger's Ghost
Haunted Mines
Free Realms Issue 1 (mentioned)
Free Realms Issue 2
Necronomicus Unleashed

Gallery
Comic

Artworks

Concept Arts

Trivia
In the Free Realms comic series, Necrowart Zombies are referred to as Spore Zombies.

wiki.title: Prince of Low Tide
wiki.text:
Were you look for the battle?

The Prince of Low Tide is a cray NPC boss that can be found in the battle of the same name, located in Seaside, where he can be found anywhere on the main beach, on the cove beach, or around the oceanfront homes. He is the cray prince who stealing souvenirs from locals and visitors, it is up to the player to come and defeat him, so he returns to the Cray Caves.

wiki.title: Cactus Jake
wiki.text:
Cactus Jake is an enemy NPC boss that can be found in the Sandscale Oasis, located in Sunstone Valley. He is the leader of a band of cactus outlaws.

Sandscale Oasis
Cactus Jake and his Cactus Outlaws have taken over the manguana watering hole. While lacking hydration, the Sandscale manguana tribe have become aggressive and began attacking travelers and residents.

TCG
220px|right

On March 21, 2013, a Trading Card Game Hero card was introduced based on Cactus Jake in the Series 5 Rumbledome! Expansion. The card's ID is 5U1.

wiki.title: Robgoblins
wiki.text:
Robgoblins are a race of goblin-like creatures. They are small creatures that live primarily in camps with other robgoblins. They have an affinity for destruction, explosives, magic and stealing.

Many robgoblins are enemies, but there are also robgoblin NPCs and questgivers.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of robgoblins in two locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Robgoblins can be found in Sacred Grove. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses. They can also be found in Sunstone Valley, although there are several differences in these two cousins. Such include a red skin tone and a default occupation as a scrapsmith. There is a scrapsmith camp just outside of the hostile area controlled by these small creatures.

wiki.title: Stone Heart
wiki.text:
Stone Heart is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Festival of Hearts. He is a heart-shaped monster, his main goal while arrived is to destroy the Love Potions in Merry Vale which will break all the people's love.

Biography
Before the Festival of Hearts, Rylan and Arianna who were two lovers met long ago and came together near a flower that grew every time they were near each other. One day, dark magic fell over the land and Rylan never showed up again. He went out on the day of dark magic, he got turned into Stone Heart. He gathered the changelings around him. Stone Heart has no love and sees the festival as an insult. He will try to crush as much of the special magic as he can so others will be as lonely as he is.

Battle
Open World
During the time that Stone Heart is arrived, bring sadness and the feeling of heart break to all the people in love. He will slowly walk along the pathways of Merry Vale giving players time to confront the boss, the Love Potions appear on the pathways of Merry Vale. The Love Potions temporarily grant players an enchanted bow with the ability to attack Stone Heart and stop the Heart Breakers from stealing Valentine Love.

Once defeated, Stone Heart drops a special treasure chest that rewards the players that assisted in that specific battle a Festival of Hearts themed item. If he wins, he will successfully destroy the Love Potion that will break all the people's love and disappear which him and the Heart Breakers ruin the Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, which will not drop anything.

wiki.title: Darkthorne
wiki.text:
Darkthorne (known as Princess Lavender) is the queen of Briarwood, and the sister of Queen Valerian.

She began ruling over Briarwood after the assassination of her parents, Geoffrey, Valerian's loyal and most trusted advisor, blamed Lavender and the Chugawugs and they were exiled. She stole half the Heartseed from the Royal Palace and took it to Briarheart, where Lavender tore the Heartseed apart and grew a new version of the World Tree and named it Briarheart Palace. She then assumed the name of Darkthorne, Ayani's twin sister.

In the Free Realms comic series, it is explained how Darkthorne was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister Queen Valerian. We learn that this is false, and at the end of the issue 6, it is explained how Geoffrey had poisoned Queen Valerian. It cames out to a happy ending where Darkthorne and the two protagonists, Dane, and Maya get an antidote to Queen Valerian and save her. Darkthorne disappears seconds before Queen Valerian wakes up.

wiki.title: Gloam Overlord
wiki.text:
The Gloam Overlord is an NPC featured as the antagonist of Free Realms. He has come to Sacred Grove to cause danger and harm to its people. The player must help Darkthorne defeat him and defend the Cobblestone Village from his evil forces. The Gloam Overlord and his will lieutenants try to corrupt the various regions of Free Realms, when a new evil appears, the player must defeat them.

History
Not much is known about him. But it is known that he is the leader of the Gloam and caused the battle in Shrouded Glade, and now he is causing harm to the Cobblestone Village.

Cobblestone Village
Now that the Gloam Overlord had come to the Cobblestone Village, he sent his forces to wreak havoc on its citizens. And Darkthorne has sent the player there to help and defeat the Gloam in the village. But soon enough, he will cause more harm, and its up to the player to save Sacred Grove.

wiki.title: Black Widow
wiki.text:
Black Widows are a race of arachnid that live exclusively in Briarwood and Blackspore Swamp. Most black widows serve as dungeon enemies with the few exceptions such as Spinnerette. Black widows found in Briarwood serve under the rule of Queen Arachnia and the forest troll boss, General Grexan; while the black widows found in Blackspore serve under the rule of Necrosis.

Baby black widows are known as hatchlings, and often appear spawning out of eggs in the dungeon instances Arachnia's Lair and Haunted Mines.

Difference
There is a difference between its gender. Male black widows tend to have smooth legs and two fangs; while the female black widows have hairy legs, four fangs, and a spike at the end of their abdomen. Although their eyes and skin are different.

wiki.title: Robbie
wiki.text:
Robbie is a robgoblin NPC that can be found at Camp Robbie, located in the Greenwood Forest. Robbie, along with Chatty, are the official mascots of Free Realms.

Robbie is also an NPC boss in Bigfoot's Lair, he used to wear the Bigfoot costume which come to attack the player in the battle.

wiki.title: Raven
wiki.text:
Raven is a harpy NPC boss featured as the primary antagonist in the Hero Rises questline. Disguised as the Bixie Queen, she attempted to take over Wugachug using gloamwater sarsaparilla. When inside the party tent, at the end of the Chug-a-Mug Challenge battle, she will appear outside the tent to tells the contestants to stop fighting. After the player come to fight Raven in Highroad Junction, she fails and got defeated by the player.

Battle
In the old tutorial area, in Highroad Junction as a world boss. When Raven is there, massive logs will appear and she will fly between them. To get up, you must find some green tornadoes and jump where they are. This will rocket you up and you can land on them. The teleport is quite frequent so be fast. Once defeated, Raven drops Raven's Treasure Chest, bixies will appear and the logs will not be there.

Gallery

Trivia
Raven was introduced in the update of August 13th, 2013.
Raven is currently the only known harpy in Sacred Grove, although Chugzy mentions that harpies are from Lavender Coast, thus implying that there are more of her kind.
Two world bosses, Raven and Nekark were supposed to have Level 20 Awakened fights similar to Necronomicus, but they were never completed before the game shut down.

wiki.text:
The Man-Eating Plant is an enemy NPC that appears throughout Briarwood.

Battle
Man-eating plants can be found wandering in Bristlewood, Briarwood and require a level 9 or above combat job to encounter. They also featured in dungeons such the Snarling Hedges and the Briar Patch.

Appearances
The Snarling Hedges
Maze Mulcher
Nettleseed Nibblers!
Bristlewood Glade
Briar Patch
Trading Card Game
Free Realms Issue 1 (mentioned)

Gallery

Trivia
In appearance, the Man-Eating Plant appears to be loosely based on the Little Shop of Horrors adaption of the Venus Flytrap.

Sources

Locations
List of wolves that may be found in the following places:

Briarwood: The wolves are found in several encounters. Vine wolves can also be related to this category of creature.

Snowhill: Mostly called 'frostfang', these wolves have a snowy white coat, and can be encountered in the Frostfang Caverns, and lone instances.

Wilds: Other wolves can be found in dungeons, roaming the wilds, and sometimes as pets.

Shrouded Gloam: Corrupted wolves are found in Shrouded Glade during the Gloam Invasion.

wiki.title: Robgoblins
wiki.text:
Robgoblins are a race of goblin-like creatures. They are small creatures that live primarily in camps with other robgoblins. They have an affinity for destruction, explosives, magic and stealing.

Many robgoblins are enemies, but there are also robgoblin NPCs and questgivers.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of robgoblins in two locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Robgoblins can be found in Sacred Grove. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses. They can also be found in Sunstone Valley, although there are several differences in these two cousins. Such include a red skin tone and a default occupation as a scrapsmith. There is a scrapsmith camp just outside of the hostile area controlled by these small creatures.

wiki.title: Trolls
wiki.text:
Trolls are a sentient race that mainly reside in the Forest Troll Village.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of trolls in any locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Regular trolls can be found in any locations expect Snowhill. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses.

Ice trolls can be found in Snowhill, they have light blue skins, large ears, big noses, and red eyes.

wiki.title: Ice Troll
wiki.text:
Ice Trolls are enemy NPCs that can be found in Snowhill. They are similar to regular trolls, only they are accustomed to cold weather. Due to this fact, they only live on terror mountain. Ice trolls are often the masters of frostfang snarlers and have been known to battle yetis. Currently, they are only found in battles with the exception of one named Gertrude who can be found south east of the Forest Troll Fort for unknown reasons.

wiki.title: Necronomicus
wiki.text:
Necronomicus is a fairy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Southern Wilds chapter of the Heroes Journal. He is the Gloam Lord of Necromancy, and is currently the only Gloam Lord in the game at this time. He mainly resides in the Fairy Cultist territory.

Quest
Mysterious Stranger
During the quest named Bixie-B-Gone, a mysterious NPC with the name plate, the Mysterious Stranger is found near the missing caravan. It is later found out the Mysterious Stranger had been Necronomicus.

Locations
Necronomicus (Temporary Quest NPC)
A little bit south of Queensfields next to the missing caravan. Disappears once talked to.

Necronomicus (Battle Boss NPC)
May be found in the battle "Necronomicus Unleashed" which can only be unlocked by getting the quest "Necronomicus Unleashed" from the Fighter's Guild Message Board in Sanctuary.

Necronomicus (Overworld Enemy NPC)
May be found via a secret passage that the player may only gain access to after completing a certain quest in the Heroes Journal.

Versions
There are two different Necronomicus enemy versions and an intractable Necronomicus NPC that can only be interacted with once in order to complete a quest for the Southern Wilds questline.

Battle

thumb|300px|Necronomicus' skeletal form
This is Necronomicus Unleashed, the difficulty 5 battle. As its description suggests, this battle is designed as a group assault, and it will require you to encounter Necronomicus in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. Through progression of the Heroes Journal Merry Vale quest, a Overworld combat battle will become available during the quest named Unmasking the Villain.

wiki.title: Bristlewood Vulture
wiki.text:
The Bristlewood Vulture is an enemy NPC that mainly reside in Bristlewood, located in Briarwood.

Battle
You will find them standing stationary somewhere in the woods and can only encounter them if you are ranked level 9 or higher in a combat job. Bristlewood vultures have a reasonably unique ability also, after they have been defeated in combat they somewhat "evolve" into an undead vulture known as a vengeful vulture.

Trivia
Bristlewood vultures resemble real life vultures except obviously with an animated look about them.

wiki.title: Cakenstein
wiki.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances

wiki.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle

wiki.title: Raven
wiki.text:
Raven is a harpy NPC boss featured as the primary antagonist in the Hero Rises questline. Disguised as the Bixie Queen, she attempted to take over Wugachug using gloamwater sarsaparilla. When inside the party tent, at the end of the Chug-a-Mug Challenge battle, she will appear outside the tent to tells the contestants to stop fighting. After the player come to fight Raven in Highroad Junction, she fails and got defeated by the player.

Battle
In the old tutorial area, in Highroad Junction as a world boss. When Raven is there, massive logs will appear and she will fly between them. To get up, you must find some green tornadoes and jump where they are. This will rocket you up and you can land on them. The teleport is quite frequent so be fast. Once defeated, Raven drops Raven's Treasure Chest, bixies will appear and the logs will not be there.

Gallery

Trivia
Raven was introduced in the update of August 13th, 2013.
Raven is currently the only known harpy in Sacred Grove, although Chugzy mentions that harpies are from Lavender Coast, thus implying that there are more of her kind.
Two world bosses, Raven and Nekark were supposed to have Level 20 Awakened fights similar to Necronomicus, but they were never completed before the game shut down.

wiki.title: Zandro Rageracer
wiki.text:
Zandro Rageracer is a dwarf NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Sunstone Valley questline. He is the leader of the Skullz that made his first appearance in the Skullz Base Camp when the player and the Freewheelers come to confront him. He obtained super-human features while being influenced by the mysterious magic known as the Gloam. With the Gloam abilities, he led a Skullz invasion of Sunstone Valley.

Biography
Before the events of the Freewheelers vs. Skullz, Zandro was once a normal person where he were grumpy and lonely, many the Freewheelers are enjoyed with each other and has feast in Wheelie Pete's. Zandro was the only one who started the Skullz. He challenged with Gus in a race, later Gus won in a race against Zandro. Zandro then met the stranger who is a part of the Gloam, he still don't know who she was. Zandro was influenced and obtained the Gloam abilities, then he use the power to convince the Dwarves to join the Skullz, and the gang had risen to power over Sunstone Valley.

wiki.title: General Wugashima
wiki.text:
General Wugashima is a chugawug enemy NPC that appears on a mountaintop located south of Wugachug during the quests Countering the Calvary and Elf Ex Machina. He is the general of the Flying Pig Dogo Ninjawugs, and one of Raven's minions while influenced by the Gloam throughout the Bugawug Queen quest series.

Ninjawug Outpost
Ninjawug Outpost is a difficulty 2 battle available during the quest Ex Elf Machina.

thumb|Gloam obilisk
During the quest named Elf Ex Machina, the player is sent to stop General Wugashima who is preparing a ninjawug attack on Wugachug by the order of Bixie Queen, Raven. During the first confrontation with General Wugashima, he claims the player's arrival was expected and begins attacking. Once defeated, he summons Ninjawugs of the Flying Pig Dojo to attack, and continues to respawn the Ninjawugs after defeat until a Gloam obilisk is destroyed by Chugzy.

Once the Gloam obilisk is destroyed, General Wugashima is no longer under the influence of Queen Raven and becomes an ally.
